limits: Single lookup overall cancellable deadline20 seconds; at most2 HTTP attempts; same immutable method and payload.
Explicit allowlist of transient transport or specified HTTP conditions; permission denial, malformed response, response-size violation and identity mismatch must not become accepted authorization.
No retry of sendMessage, configured_delivery, worker task, model call, lease transition or whole request as part of this change.
Preserve current post-read source/CONTROL/actor and before-send lease checks; late success cannot resurrect an invalidated request.
Keep original SQS redelivery and the separate start/send-time authorization checks explicit: per-lookup two attempts is not a global two-call guarantee.
Send timeout or uncertain response still yields UNKNOWN and one external send attempt; no safe-read retry policy may reach the sending branch.
Preserve redacted errors with no token-bearing URL, payload, response text or original exception chain.
Use existing cancellable transport; retries and optional delay share the20-second total, with no detached continuation.
required_tests: Transient read failure then success: exact same payload and2 attempts, no third.
Two transient failures exhaust safely; invalid membership or identity cannot authorize generation or delivery.
Permanent rejection, malformed/oversized response and disallowed method do not enter broad retries.
Actual transport cancellation for timeout during connection/header/body; total bound spans all attempts and any delay.
Send failure/timeout remains one attempt with UNKNOWN/lease cleanup and no second send.
CONTROL/source/actor invalidation during lookup or retry blocks subsequent generation/send through existing owners.
Traceback/log tests exclude token, request body and upstream exception text.
